svg.text: 6-Layer AI Digital Twin - Data Ingestion - Feature Pipeline - ML Suite - Safety - API - Frontend
LAYER 6 -- NEXT.JS CONTROLLER DASHBOARD + PASSENGER WEB/APP
LAYER 5 -- FASTAPI APPLICATION SERVER + DECISION INTELLIGENCE ENGINE
Instant state push to all clients
LAYER 4 -- SAFETY INTERLOCK + AUDIT LEDGER (Zero ML - Fully Deterministic)
5 deterministic rules: Domain sanity - Recovery rate - Quantile order - Delay clamping - Cancellation flag
human_ack_required = True when delay > 300 min - Zero cases where ML overrides physics
Append-only hash chain: block n links prev_hash to curr_hash - Sealed before arrival
1,962 blocks - verify_chain_integrity() passes - Zero retroactive score manipulation
LAYER 3 -- MULTI-TIER MACHINE LEARNING SUITE + UNCERTAINTY QUANTIFICATION
LAYER 2 -- LEAKAGE-SAFE FEATURE PIPELINE (Shared Training and Serving Parity)
Identical snapshot for training and live serving
Time-split isolation - No future leakage guaranteed
Block occupancy - yard queue - corridor topology
Strongly typed - Physics features + Weather + Calendar + Network
Validated FEATURE_NAMES contract shared across train and serve
LAYER 1 -- DATA INGESTION + CANONICAL SQLITE STORE
Single source of truth - no mocks
Corridor: New Delhi (NDLS) to Ghaziabad (GZB) to Kanpur Central (CNB) to Lucknow Charbagh (LKO) -- 440 km -- 8 stations
Overall MAE: 10.72 min -- vs NTES: -40.5% -- 25,203 test samples -- 6-fold rolling-origin temporal CV -- 268+ unit tests
